snaps.name: hopper_lid-latch-mu-low

rows.detail: 4.6 N to pull apart vs 4.3 N required (upper bound: the lowest edition's datasheet modulus)

limits: closed-form small-deflection beam theory (Covestro/Bayer method): no large deflection, contact, creep or fatigue
one mating part assumed rigid unless share < 1 is given
permissible strain and secant modulus are the caller's inputs; values in MATERIALS are guide data, not measurements of a particular batch or print
a printed part's inter-layer strength and strain are lower than in-plane: the datasheet filaments carry this per direction; any other material in a layered process needs a sourced process_factor
a pass has no extra margin: the guide's own examples design to half the permissible strain
small deflection is assumed: when the deflection exceeds about a tenth of the arm length a warning is given and the closed form overestimates force and strain accuracy
hook-face geometry, wall deflection at the root and mould release are not checked
the model, not the part: print a coupon and measure the force and the strain at failure
snaps.method: Covestro, Snap-Fit Joints for Plastics - A Design Guide

material.source: Bambu Lab PETG Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0 (PDF of 2026-01-25), p. 2, Mechanical Properties: https://store.bblcdn.com/s1/default/cb94589bf7994fdcbfa833badefae9cd/Bambu_PETG_Basic_Technical_Data_Sheet.pdf; Bambu Lab PETG Basic Technical Data Sheet V2.0 (PDF of 2023-06-26), p. 2, Mechanical Properties: https://www.additive-x.com/shop/mpattachments/file/viewonline/id/580/product_id/2330
editions: Bambu Lab PETG Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu Lab PETG Basic Technical Data Sheet V2.0
material.note: V3.0 describes a reformulated filament sold under the same name, its bars not said to be annealed; V2.0's were. A spool does not say which it is, so both are kept and the cautious one taken per quantity: here V3.0 for both (allowable 0.96-1.28 % against V2.0's 2.3 %, modulus 2780 / 2550 MPa against 1460 / 1120). A printed coupon (#94) should record which filament it used.
